title: Uhlu Lwemibuzo Yempilo Yengqondo - 9
instructions: Emasontweni amabili adlule, uvamise kangakanani ukuphazanyiswa yilezi zinkinga ezilandelayo?

questions.text: Ukulahlekelwa intshisekelo noma injabulo ezintweni ozenzayo
Ubunzima bokulala, ukuhlala ulele, noma ukulala kakhulu
Ukungabi nesifiso sokudla noma ukudla kakhulu
Ukuzizwa kabi ngawe noma sengathi wehlise wena noma umndeni wakho
Ubunzima bokugxila ezintweni njengokufunda noma ukubuka ithelevishini
Ukuhamba noma ukukhuluma kancane kakhulu abantu bakuqaphele, noma ukuphambene nalokho ungahlaliseki kakhulu kunokuvamile
Imicabango yokuthi kungaba ngcono uma ushonile noma uzilimaza
